# R5.11 — Execute and retain isolated instrument oracle attempts

## Summary

Implements the X5 owner seam (REQ-E-007 primary): `OracleRunner::attempt`
on `hh-bench` persists `verification.oracle.invoked` on the instrument run
**before** the pinned unchanged oracle executes over the sealed submission,
then retains `verification.oracle.verdict` with the mapped outcome — bound
to subject, submission, oracle, attempt, policy and cost (PADR-R5-1 A.1
item 5 / A.3). Frozen instrument-only regrade count/time/resource bounds
are enforced against the durable stream; every failure mode is a typed
oracle failure, never a fabricated reward. Contract:
`docs/tickets/180_R5.11__oracle.md`.

**Requirement ids:** REQ-E-007 (primary); REQ-E-102, REQ-E-103, REQ-E-204
(contributing only — never duplicate ownership).

- `docs/adr/ADR-0390-…` — 8 owned landing decisions; BL-47 sources +

## Design decisions (ADR-0390)

New classes under the existing plane (not reuse of `verification.validator.*`
— a foreign payload would pollute `bind.rs` folds); `attempt_no` derived
from committed invoked rows (cap enforced across crashes); invocation
append precedes execution (`InvocationNotPersisted` ⇒ oracle never runs);
seal proof is structural (`action.environment.snapshot{purpose:
"submission_seal"}` on the subject run); bounds enforced on the raw
observation; `shared`/`hosted` spell `separate_verifier:false` +
`tamper:"n/a{no_detector}"`; instrument run = `RunKind::Experiment`
minimal-manifest idiom (subject stream untouched, no relaunch).
